findings.highlight: we’ll prepare for battle and go to the Ryuudou Temple before the date changes
findings.evidenceJa: 日付が変わるまでに戦闘準備を済ませ、柳洞寺に乗り込む
findings.governingReading: Rin will finish battle preparations by midnight and declares that they will then invade Ryuudou Temple.
findings.explanation: The English places both preparation and the temple assault before midnight, extending the deadline beyond its source scope.

findings.highlight: The Azoth Sword, which is as close as we’re going to get to the gem sword
findings.evidenceJa: 出来るだけ宝石剣に似せたアゾット剣
findings.governingReading: Rin made or selected an Azoth sword modeled as closely as possible on the jeweled sword.
findings.explanation: The English turns deliberate modeling into a vague limit on what they can obtain.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka hands me a dagger.
findings.evidenceJa: はい、と短剣を手渡してくる遠坂。
findings.governingReading: With a brief “here,” Rin hands Shirou the short sword.
findings.explanation: The English drops Rin’s accompanying utterance and the demonstrative handoff beat.

findings.highlight: The dagger is a ritualistic equipment.
findings.evidenceJa: 渡された短剣は儀礼用の物だ。
findings.governingReading: The handed short sword is an object for ritual use.
findings.explanation: “A ritualistic equipment” is grammatically malformed and makes the concrete object sound like an abstract equipment class.

findings.highlight: Even an amateur like me can feel how much magical energy is stored in this thing.
findings.evidenceJa: 半人前の俺でさえ判るほど強大な魔力が蓄積されていた
findings.governingReading: Magical energy so enormous that even half-trained Shirou can recognize it has accumulated in the blade.
findings.explanation: The English preserves stored energy but omits its enormous degree and the accumulation state.

findings.highlight: this is nothing compared to the shadow, but it’s still a hundred times more than my magical energy capacity
findings.evidenceJa: 桜の纏った影に比べたら掌一つ分の魔力ではあるのだが、それでも俺の許容量からすれば何百倍
findings.governingReading: Against the shadow enveloping Sakura it is only a palmful, yet it is hundreds of times Shirou’s capacity.
findings.explanation: The English removes the palmful scale and Sakura’s enveloping relation, then reduces plural hundreds to exactly one hundred.

findings.highlight: maybe she’s really stingy when it comes to money
findings.evidenceJa: お金に関してはすごく厳しい人間なのかもしれない
findings.governingReading: Shirou wonders whether apparently openhanded Rin may be extremely strict about money.
findings.explanation: “Stingy” assigns miserly character where the source describes financial strictness, distorting the joke built on her costly sacrifice.

findings.highlight: I can manage to move around
findings.evidenceJa: 飛んだり跳ねたりぐらいはなんとか
findings.governingReading: Rin can just about manage active jumping and leaping.
findings.explanation: The English weakens the concrete extent of her physical mobility into generic movement.

findings.highlight: I haven’t healed to the point where I can use magic again
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術を使えるほど魔力は回復してない
findings.governingReading: Rin’s magical energy has not recovered enough for magecraft.
findings.explanation: The English makes her body’s healing the limiting quantity and calls magecraft generic magic.

findings.highlight: absurd powers
findings.evidenceJa: 領域外の力
findings.governingReading: The sword exercises power outside the ordinary domain, with precedent said to include stopping the falling moon.
findings.explanation: “Absurd” conveys amazement but removes the technical claim that the power lies beyond the relevant domain.

findings.highlight: let’s go back to your room
findings.evidenceJa: 部屋に戻りましょう
findings.governingReading: Rin proposes returning indoors and heads toward the living room.
findings.explanation: The dialogue invents Shirou’s personal room, immediately contradicting the narrated destination.

findings.highlight: I have to be there in case something happens, right?
findings.evidenceJa: わたしもフォローに回った方がいいでしょ？
findings.governingReading: Rin argues that she should take a supporting or backup role in case of trouble.
findings.explanation: The English keeps emergency presence but removes her proposed active support role.

findings.highlight: That’s the biggest compromise we can make.
findings.evidenceJa: それが精一杯の譲歩ね
findings.governingReading: Illya judges Rin waiting immediately outside to be the utmost concession available from Rin.
findings.explanation: The English makes the concession collectively owned by “we,” blurring whose insistence has been negotiated.

findings.highlight: I decide to ask Tohsaka something before I follow.
findings.evidenceJa: はた、とある事を閃いた
findings.governingReading: As he is about to follow Illya, Shirou suddenly thinks of something.
findings.explanation: The English replaces a sudden inspiration with a deliberate decision to ask a question, spoiling the improvised pretext that follows.

findings.highlight: I’m going to go do my best
findings.evidenceJa: ちょっくら気合いれてくる
findings.governingReading: Shirou casually says he is off to put some spirit into it or steel himself.
findings.explanation: The English flattens his breezy, self-bracing idiom into generic effort.

findings.highlight: after everything is over
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯戦争が終わった後
findings.governingReading: Shirou plans to obtain retroactive approval after the Holy Grail War ends.
findings.explanation: The English removes the exact event whose completion defines when he will disclose the arm’s use.

findings.highlight: a dagger that’s just like it
findings.evidenceJa: 宝石剣に真似た短剣
findings.governingReading: The short sword is modeled on the jeweled sword.
findings.explanation: “Just like it” promotes intentional imitation into successful close equivalence, overstating the aid it provides Projection.

findings.highlight: I’m sure the sword was there at that time.
findings.evidenceJa: 彼の魔道翁が手にする剣もちゃんと見ていた筈だもの
findings.governingReading: The inherited record should have clearly seen the sword held by the old man of the Kaleidoscope.
findings.explanation: The English reduces a recorded person holding the sword to the sword merely being present, removing the wielder and observation relation.

findings.highlight: the pressure of two hundred years
findings.evidenceJa: 二百年前の記録へ遡る圧力
findings.governingReading: Shirou will undergo the pressure of tracing backward into a record from two hundred years ago.
findings.explanation: The English turns pressure generated by retrospective movement through the record into the undifferentiated weight of a duration.

findings.highlight: Her arms are as well.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺を正面から抱いたイリヤの腕も、小刻みに震えている
findings.governingReading: Illya’s arms, embracing Shirou directly from the front, are trembling in small increments along with her voice.
findings.explanation: The English preserves trembling arms but removes the frightened embrace and its precise physical relation.

findings.highlight: all my senses are within her memory
findings.evidenceJa: 五感の全てがイリヤの記録とやらに含まれた
findings.governingReading: All five senses may have been incorporated into what Illya calls her record.
findings.explanation: The English turns incorporation into spatial presence and substitutes personal memory for the inherited record.

findings.highlight: There’s no pain, the cognition of pain doesn’t matter now, I’m swallowed by my injury, I’m falling into a swirling maelstrom of pain.
findings.evidenceJa: 痛みのない、痛みという認識はもはや該当しない自己の損傷に蝕まれながら、何重にも回転する痛みの中に落ちていく
findings.governingReading: Damage to the self has exceeded the category of pain even as Shirou falls through many rotating layers of pain.
findings.explanation: The comma-spliced English makes pain both absent and irrelevant without preserving the source’s distinction between damage beyond recognition and the layered pain surrounding it.

findings.highlight: Multi-layered Crests are carved on a bare rock that’s over fifty meters in radius.
findings.evidenceJa: 半径五十メートル以上、すり鉢状の岩肌に刻まれた何十もの多重層刻印
findings.governingReading: Dozens of multilayered markings are carved into a mortar-shaped rock surface with a radius over fifty meters.
findings.explanation: The English assigns the fifty-meter radius to a bare rock and loses the basin geometry and dozens of inscriptions.

findings.highlight: a large observatory
findings.evidenceJa: 大きな大きな観測装置
findings.governingReading: The circuit resembles a very large observation apparatus rotating alone in the Arizona wilderness.
findings.explanation: “Observatory” changes an instrument or apparatus into a building or facility and weakens the repeated magnitude.

findings.highlight: the beautiful spider’s nest
findings.evidenceJa: 美しい蜘蛛の巣
findings.governingReading: Justeaze stands at the center of a beautiful spiderweb formed by the circuits.
findings.explanation: The English changes the visual structure from a web to the spider’s nest.

findings.highlight: accompanied by Makiri Zouken and Tohsaka Nagato
findings.evidenceJa: マキリ臓硯と遠坂永人を従えた
findings.governingReading: The great magus praised as the winter saint had Makiri Zouken and Tohsaka Nagato in attendance or under her leadership.
findings.explanation: “Accompanied by” removes Justeaze’s superior directional relation over the two founders.

findings.highlight: Justeaze becomes the key reenacting the ancient sorcery.
findings.evidenceJa: 古の魔法を再現しようと試みる
findings.governingReading: With Justeaze as the key, the Greater Grail attempts to reproduce an ancient Magic.
findings.explanation: The English turns an attempt into ongoing successful reenactment and again weakens capital-M Magic into sorcery.

findings.highlight: The old man knows as well as Makiri and Tohsaka do that the Holy Grail is a mere wishbringer.
findings.evidenceJa: マキリや遠坂だけでは、聖杯はただの願望機にすぎない事を、その老人はよく知っていた
findings.governingReading: The old man knew well that with Makiri and Tohsaka alone, the Grail would be no more than a wish-granting device.
findings.explanation: The English makes Makiri and Tohsaka fellow knowers instead of the insufficient founders in the proposition the old man knows.

findings.highlight: I did, so my body was ripped in half.
findings.evidenceJa: 意識を割いたから、体が半分になった
findings.governingReading: Within the inherited-record experience, diverting awareness makes Shirou’s perceived body or viewpoint shrink by half.
findings.explanation: “Ripped in half” promotes the altered self-perception into a literal catastrophic bodily injury and adds violent tearing.

findings.highlight: the man standing in front of the Great Holy Grail
findings.evidenceJa: 大聖杯を眼下に見据え、事の顛末を見守る一人の老人
findings.governingReading: One old man overlooks the Greater Grail below and watches the course of events.
findings.explanation: The English relocates him in front of the Grail and removes both his elevated viewpoint and attentive observation.

findings.highlight: sears through my eyes and into my brain
findings.evidenceJa: 眼球はおろか脳髄まで焼滅させる
findings.governingReading: The brilliance burns away not only the eyeballs but even the brain matter.
findings.explanation: The English conveys penetration by heat but weakens total burning destruction and the escalation from eyeballs to brain tissue.

findings.highlight: I can’t analyze its structure and project it.
findings.evidenceJa: その構造を解析し投影する事しかできない
findings.governingReading: Although Shirou cannot comprehend the theory, all he can do is analyze the structure and project it.
findings.explanation: The English inserts a negation and reverses the one capability the Japanese explicitly preserves.

findings.highlight: It’s alien technology.
findings.evidenceJa: 異星というより異星系
findings.governingReading: The governing principle is not merely like another planet but like another star system.
findings.explanation: The English substitutes a technology label and removes the escalating spatial comparison.

findings.highlight: beyond the reach of modern man
findings.evidenceJa: まだ幼年期にいる人類には届かない
findings.governingReading: It lies beyond humanity while humanity is still in its infancy.
findings.explanation: The English replaces the species-development image with a generic contrast against modern people.

findings.highlight: My eyes are burned out, my brains are burned out.
findings.evidenceJa: 焼き切れた眼球、焼き切れた脳神経
findings.governingReading: Shirou reaches with burned-out eyeballs and burned-out cranial nerves.
findings.explanation: The English replaces cranial nerves with the anatomically malformed plural “brains.”

findings.highlight: [blank page]
findings.evidenceJa: そこまでよ！　戻りなさいシロウ……！
findings.governingReading: Illya urgently orders Shirou to stop there and return.
findings.explanation: mirror moon leaves the entire active intervention blank, removing Illya’s first attempt to recall him.

findings.highlight: I can’t back out now.
findings.evidenceJa: このまま このまま戻ることなど、どうして出来る。
findings.governingReading: Shirou repeats “like this” as he asks how he could possibly return in his current state.
findings.explanation: The English removes the repetition and changes returning from the record into backing out of a decision.

findings.highlight: [blank page]
findings.evidenceJa: 諦めなさい……！　このまま消え去りたいのシロウ！
findings.governingReading: Illya orders Shirou to give up and asks whether he wants to vanish completely if he continues.
findings.explanation: mirror moon leaves the entire active warning blank, removing both her command and the risk of Shirou’s annihilation.

findings.highlight: was I pushed back by something?
findings.evidenceJa: 何かに跳ね飛ばされたのか
findings.governingReading: Shirou cannot tell whether he jumped himself or something sent him flying.
findings.explanation: “Pushed back” weakens the violent launch that has his body airborne before he falls on his back.

findings.highlight: I’ll let you off the hook this time since it paid off
findings.evidenceJa: 上手くいったから許してあげる
findings.governingReading: Illya forgives Shirou’s disobedience because the Projection succeeded.
findings.explanation: “It paid off” frames the dangerous disobedience itself as justified by benefit rather than naming the successful manufacture.

findings.highlight: She points at my face
findings.evidenceJa: 俺の鼻先に指を突きつけて
findings.governingReading: Illya sharply thrusts a finger to the tip of Shirou’s nose while scolding him.
findings.explanation: The English generalizes the precise comic gesture to pointing somewhere at his face.

findings.highlight: this blade wouldn’t cut paper
findings.evidenceJa: こんな刀身じゃ物を斬りつけるコトもできないだろう
findings.governingReading: Shirou thinks a blade like this probably could not cut an object.
findings.explanation: The English invents paper as a benchmark and turns broad apparent uselessness into a familiar idiom.

findings.highlight: a flawless blade works
findings.evidenceJa: 非の打ち所のない剣製
findings.governingReading: Illya praises the act of sword manufacture or sword Projection as flawless.
findings.explanation: “A flawless blade works” is grammatically malformed and fails to express the process she is praising.

findings.highlight: Rin’s going to try to use the second
findings.evidenceJa: リンは若輩の身でありながら第二を駆使しよう
findings.governingReading: Although still a young and inexperienced practitioner, Rin is attempting to wield the Second.
findings.explanation: The English removes the exceptional contrast between Rin’s junior status and the True Magic she will attempt to wield.

findings.highlight: Every department would be running to put them on trial.
findings.evidenceJa: 各部門あげての裁判沙汰になりかねない
findings.governingReading: The affair could become a trial involving every department of the Association.
findings.explanation: The English invents departments physically rushing and makes them direct prosecutors, obscuring the scale of institutional involvement.

findings.highlight: multi-dimensional refractory phenomenon
findings.evidenceJa: 多重次元屈折現象
findings.governingReading: The formal description is a multidimensional refraction phenomenon.
findings.explanation: “Refractory” means resistant or difficult to treat and mistranslates the optical and dimensional mechanism of refraction.

findings.highlight: an assignment from the sorcerer that the Tohsaka magi must pursue for a long, long time
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂の魔術師がもっと長い時間をかけてたどり着かなくちゃいけない、魔法使いからの宿題
findings.governingReading: The blueprint is homework from a practitioner of True Magic that a Tohsaka magus must eventually reach after much longer work.
findings.explanation: The English changes reaching the technical achievement into indefinitely pursuing an assignment and weakens Magic user to “sorcerer.”

findings.highlight: is a sorcerer
findings.evidenceJa: 魔法使いなのか
findings.governingReading: Shirou realizes Rin’s grandmaster is a practitioner of True Magic.
findings.explanation: “Sorcerer” fails to preserve the setting’s categorical distinction between a magus and one of the few users of True Magic.

findings.highlight: I get dizzy.
findings.evidenceJa: 気を抜くと目の前が霞む
findings.governingReading: When Shirou relaxes his guard, the view before him clouds over.
findings.explanation: The English replaces a specific visual failure with generic dizziness.

findings.highlight: feel the pendant digging into my torn flesh, and keep my consciousness
findings.evidenceJa: ペンダントを裂けた肌の肉に突き刺して、意識を保つ
findings.governingReading: Shirou deliberately drives the pendant into the flesh beneath his torn skin to remain conscious.
findings.explanation: The English makes the penetration something he passively feels, obscuring his deliberate self-inflicted stimulus.

findings.highlight: She’s just speaking in a language I don’t understand.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂は知らない言葉で喋っている
findings.governingReading: Rin’s speech consists of words Shirou does not know; the problem is comprehension rather than hearing.
findings.explanation: The English promotes unknown words into a separate language, resolving the nature of his cognitive failure without support.

findings.highlight: My memory’s vague.
findings.evidenceJa: 記憶がとんでいる。
findings.governingReading: A portion of Shirou’s memory has vanished or skipped out.
findings.explanation: “Vague” weakens an actual discontinuity in memory into ordinary indistinct recollection.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka grabs me.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂が飛びついてくる。
findings.governingReading: Rin springs or leaps at Shirou despite appearing startlingly slow to him.
findings.explanation: The English keeps only the eventual grab and removes the abrupt movement that contrasts with his slowed perception.

findings.highlight: Why did I pick it up?
findings.evidenceJa: 何処でだろう。
findings.governingReading: Shirou cannot remember where he picked the pendant up.
findings.explanation: The English changes a missing location into a missing reason for taking the object.

findings.highlight: It’s something I shouldn’t forget
findings.evidenceJa: 簡単な、忘れられない事なのに
findings.governingReading: It should be a simple event intrinsically impossible to forget.
findings.explanation: The English changes the paradox of inaccessible unforgettable memory into a moral or practical obligation not to forget.

findings.highlight: have it on me until the end
findings.evidenceJa: 肌身離さず、最期まで
findings.governingReading: The borrowed words say to keep the precious pendant constantly on his person until his final moment.
findings.explanation: “Until the end” weakens the death-marked spelling of Shirou’s last moment.

findings.highlight: they’re the same
findings.evidenceJa: そっくりだな
findings.governingReading: Shirou remarks that the two pendants look exactly alike or strikingly similar.
findings.explanation: The English states numerical identity before Rin immediately corrects the pendants’ different remaining contents.

findings.highlight: there’s a meaning behind the usage of it
findings.evidenceJa: 使われたからには意味があるんだわ
findings.governingReading: Because the pendant was used, Rin concludes that even its tiny remaining charge must have significance.
findings.explanation: The English makes meaning vaguely lie behind “the usage” instead of expressing Rin’s causal inference from the fact of use.

findings.highlight: walks off with Illya
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤの手を掴んで歩き出した
findings.governingReading: Rin grabs Illya’s hand and starts walking.
findings.explanation: The English preserves joint departure but removes Rin’s sudden physical initiative.

findings.highlight: stay in your room
findings.evidenceJa: 部屋で大人しくしてなさい
findings.governingReading: Rin orders Shirou to remain quietly indoors or in the room during the hour’s rest.
findings.explanation: The English specifies Shirou’s personal bedroom even though the Japanese does not identify it here.

findings.highlight: bad temper borders on outright hostility
findings.evidenceJa: 不機嫌さはほとんど殺気だった
findings.governingReading: Rin’s displeasure is almost killing intent.
findings.explanation: “Outright hostility” removes the nearly murderous intensity of her warning about Shirou’s bleeding hand.
